newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian stocks end mixed, engineering firm soars.
newsitem.headline: Colombian stocks end mixed, engineering firm soars.

text.p: Colombian stocks ended mixed in lackluster trade as U.S. Thanksgiving dampened foreign investment fund activity here, brokers said.

Medellin's IBOMED general price index inched down 0.04 percent to end at 13,296.43 on a trading volume of 1.1 billion pesos while Bogota's IBB rose a paper-thin 0.09 percent, ending at 842.67. Volume in Bogota was 1.3 billion.
"The market was affected by the U.S. holiday, which kept foreign investors away from Colombia's exchanges," a broker said.

He said there was substantial activity among some thinly shares, however, most notably Distral S.A. engineering firm which rose 20 percent to 30 pesos a share on what brokers described as a cross-trade involving more than 450 million pesos of shares.

A company source confirmed that a German investment group expressed interest in buying up a minority stake in Distral, Colombia's largest engineering firm in sales and assets, but declined further comment.
Other movers included insurer Aseguradora Grancolombiana which rose 10 percent to close at 15.40 pesos per share.
Actively traded shares closed mostly unchanged with the exception of Banco de Bogota, which slipped 0.61 percent to end at 5,900 pesos per share on a trading volume of 138.8 million pesos in Bogota.
Cadenalco, the country's leading retailer, dropped 0.11 percent in Medellin to end the day at 885 pesos per share.
